text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hereditary Spherocytosis. The infant presents with macrocytic anemia (MCV 100) and normal white blood cells; while the CBC suggests an issue with red blood cell production or destruction, the specific combination of apnea and severe anemia in an infant is highly suggestive of an underlying metabolic disorder or severe hemolytic process where the body struggles to maintain oxygenation, leading to apneic episodes. The next step is to evaluate the reticulocyte count and perform a peripheral blood smear to confirm hemolysis. REQUEST TEST: Reticulocyte_Count. REQUEST TEST: Peripheral_Blood_Smear.
